description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of Git clone operations, specifically measuring the speed of cloning with a reference repository. It includes setup steps, such as creating a shared repository, advancing the base repository with a new commit, and performing the clone with reference options.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a shell test case expecting success, with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
